title: Sprite2d, frame coords, Error index out of bounds
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.8.dev2.official [7220d456d]
v4.7.1.stable.official [a13da4feb]
v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Dragging right and left on a Sprite2D node's Inspector, Animation, Frame Coords x input box:
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 3 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
> Set frame_coords
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 5 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 7 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 6 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 2 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -1 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -5 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -7 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).

### Steps to reproduce

- open the project: [sprite_frame_coord_out_of_bounds.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369165/sprite_frame_coord_out_of_bounds.zip)
- at the bottom, open the panel: Output
- in the scene panel, select: Sprite2D
- in the inspector, unfold: Animation
- on the Frame Coords x input box, click arrow up

### Issue:
The Output panel shows:
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 1 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   Set frame_coords

### Expected:
Clamp the Frames Coords value to the range, 0 to the Hframes value minus one.


### Notes:
The same error appears when clicking on arrow down in the Frame Coords x input box.
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -1 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   Set frame_coords

Or when left mouse button dragging on the input box:
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 3 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
> Set frame_coords
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 5 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 7 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 6 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 4 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = 2 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -1 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -5 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).
>   ERROR: scene/2d/sprite_2d.cpp:315 - Index p_coord.x = -7 is out of bounds (hframes = 1).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[sprite_frame_coord_out_of_bounds.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/30369165/sprite_frame_coord_out_of_bounds.zip)
